plugins/claude-code-guards/hooks: Registers four PreToolUse hooks that only answer ask, deny or nothing. None edits files, sends data or allows a call the person's settings would block. A failing guard asks rather than allowing.
plugins/claude-code-guards/scripts: Python standard library only. Reads the hook input and, for pushes, runs read-only git commands (remote get-url, rev-parse, log). Writes only an empty per-session marker in the system temp folder. Tested in scripts/test_guards.py.
plugins/claude-code-session-meter/hooks: Registers one UserPromptSubmit hook that only warns, or holds one prompt per limit when the person turns hard_stop on. A failing hook stays silent, so it can never block the person. It sends nothing and changes no file of theirs.
plugins/claude-code-session-meter/script: Python standard library only. statusline.py runs read-only git commands (rev-parse, rev-list, status) with a 1 second timeout and reads the plugin list and guards overlay. Both scripts write only small JSON files named by a hash of the session id in the system temp folder. Tested in scripts/test_meter.py.
plugins/private-words/skills/private-wor: scan.py reads the user's list, the repo and its Git log. Its only write is gh secret set, on request, by standard input. It prints no word.
plugins/read-only-researcher/agents: One subagent limited to Read, Grep, Glob, WebSearch and WebFetch, with Bash, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Agent disallowed, so it cannot change files, run commands or delegate.
